name: Ahmad bin Razali
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Formula 1, fueled by late-night races and a deep fascination with the engineering intricacies of the cars. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the University of Malaya, specializing in automotive dynamics. After graduating, he joined a local racing team, cutting his teeth on smaller touring car series before progressing to a regional GT championship. His meticulous approach to data analysis and his ability to translate driver feedback into tangible car setup improvements quickly earned him a reputation as a reliable and insightful engineer.

Ahmad is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to distill complex technical information into easily understandable terms for both drivers and mechanics. He believes in building strong relationships within the team, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute their best. His commitment extends beyond the purely technical; he's always looking for ways to optimize team performance through improved communication and workflow.

What sets Ahmad apart is his holistic understanding of the racing ecosystem. He doesn't just focus on the car; he considers the driver's physical and mental state, the impact of weather conditions, and the strategic nuances of each race. This comprehensive approach, combined with his unwavering loyalty, makes him a highly valuable asset to any team.
